description_en: Publishes a specified version of an edge container application, allowing users to iterate application versions through this operation
description_zh: 发布边缘容器的指定版本，用户可以通过此接口进行应用的版本迭代
kebab_example: aliyun esa publish-edge-container-app-version --app-id app-880688675783790000 --version-id ver-879626371616510000 --publish-env prod --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

Obtain the AppId by calling CreateEdgeContainerApp. 2) Obtain the VersionId by calling CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion (which requires the AppId). 3) The complete call chain is CreateEdgeContainerApp → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion → PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

AppId 通过 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建获取；2) VersionId 通过 CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion（需传入 AppId）创建获取；3) 完整调用链为 CreateEdgeContainerApp → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion → PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The publishing environment. Valid values:

prod: production environment.
staging: staging environment
parameters.help_zh:
发布的环境，取值如下：

prod: 生产环境。
staging：预发环境
parameters.name: publish_env

parameters.help_en: The publishing percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.name: percentage

parameters.help_en:
The time when the publishing starts. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used by default.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
开始进行发布的时间，不写则默认为当前时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The publishing type. Valid values:
percentage: Publish by percentage.

region: Publish by region.

If this parameter is not specified, percentage-based publishing is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
发布类型，支持如下两种：
percentage：按照百分比发布。

region：按照区域发布。

若不填写，默认使用百分比发布
parameters.name: publish_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a full release. This parameter takes effect only when PublishType is set to region
parameters.help_zh: 是否全量发布。该字段仅当 PublishType设置为 region 时生效
parameters.name: full_release
